understanding: The previously open interface details are now explained: parameters() supplies all adjustable tensors; the embedding-gradient norm squares/sums/root-combines all table signals. A nonzero gradient confirms influence reaches embeddings, whereas lower recomputed loss confirms this fixed task improved.
materials_and_labels: Embedding weight table has5 rows×8 features. Norm is one aggregate over that table's .grad. -100 is a target-ignore sentinel, distinct from any valid token ID; all three ignored targets make the objective invalid.
expected_change: Later pages should introduce batches and optimizer history. Current loop diagnostic is complete; a new-data check must be separate.
confusion_and_quote: Unit1 uncertainty about parameters()/norm() is resolved here without changing that saved checkpoint. Loop counts already had the range(12)/twelve draws correspondence in1.14, so range(40) needs no new rule to interpret repetitions. No remaining necessary gap.「固定題刻意允許記憶；新題改善需要另留資料。」keeps the conclusion bounded.
missing_visuals: None required; the text now names the parameter table, signal aggregation, sequence of state changes and failure case.

concept_checks.identity: Nonzero gradient and decreased loss are two different pieces of evidence.
concept_checks.mechanism: backward propagates objective sensitivity to embedding weights; optimizer changes parameters, then a new forward computes after loss.
concept_checks.need: Locate whether the loop failed to carry signals or failed to improve the fixed task.
concept_checks.usage: Inspect parameter registration, whether step ran and whether gradients were cleared prematurely; do not infer learning merely from positive norm.
concept_checks.example_scope: Memorization is intentionally allowed here; held-out generalization is not claimed.
concept_checks.source_quote: 梯度大小大於0，只說這張表收到訊號；代價下降才說明更新改善了固定題。

concept_checks.identity: Tool convention -100 excludes a target from learning.
concept_checks.mechanism: All three targets excluded leaves no learning objective, so masked_loss raises rather than reporting a fake successful run.
concept_checks.need: Prevent absent training targets from masquerading as completed training.
concept_checks.usage: Set all y entries to-100; expect explicit all-labels-ignored error.
concept_checks.example_scope: A failure-case check for this API, not a universal convention for every library.
concept_checks.source_quote: 這個工具約定-100表示忽略答案，所以三格都忽略等於沒有學習目標。
